=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:zombie_queued_live_count() function | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `repo` argument used to build the API URL is not validated before it is passed to `gh api`.
  WHY: The reviewer says a tampered or misinterpreted repo string from `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` could add parameters to the `gh api` command or change the target URL (reviewer said MAJOR); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash each say the regex at gh_helpers.sh:4485 disproves this.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:183-190 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `zombie_queued_live_count` regex for `zq_fallback_total` has no limit on digit count, while the main implementation enforces `{1,12}`.
  WHY: An unexpectedly large number from the API could cause problems when the script parses or uses it later (reviewer said NIT); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash make the same point as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:779-781 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The handling of `rc=1` (read 1 fails) could separate the error types for `lookup=queued_runs` and `lookup=wedged_runs` more clearly in the warning message.
  WHY: The warning is somewhat generic, but the reviewer says it causes no runtime correctness failure because the script still dispatches safely (reviewer said NIT).
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:zombie_queued_live_count() | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The two API reads of `actions/runs` are not atomic, so the total queued count can change between the first read and the second (wedged filter) read.
  WHY: The live queued count can be slightly off; the reviewer says this is acceptable for an estimate but undocumented (reviewer said NIT); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say the clamp and the code comment at gh_helpers.sh:4518 cover it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:fallback `zombie_queued_live_count`, line 188, `[[ "${zq_fallback_total}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || return 1` | HARDENING_SUGGESTION (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1)
  PROBLEM: The fallback accepts a total of any length, while the main helper limits it to `{1,12}` digits, so a huge value would reach the `-ge` comparison at line 779 without a bound (only when gh_helpers.sh cannot be sourced).
  WHY: Suggested fix: change the regex to `^[0-9]{1,12}$` to match the helper (1 line).
